notes.title: One filled button per screen
notes.body: This is the only **filled** button on the dashboard. Every other card action is `ghost`, so the next step is unambiguous. If a second card ever needs a filled button, we change this rule together rather than per screen.
notes.author: Ana

notes.title: Do we show the count when it is zero?
notes.body: The badge disappears at zero today. An empty state on the card would read better — needs a product call.
notes.author: Ana

notes.title: Opens on the first day with slots
notes.body: Not on today. A patient landing on an empty Monday reads it as "nothing is available" and leaves.
notes.author: Ana

notes.title: Slots stay at least 44px tall
notes.body: Thumb target on mobile. Three columns on mobile, four from tablet up.
notes.author: Ana

notes.title: Waitlist or call?
notes.body: The empty variant offers a phone link. If we ship a waitlist this becomes a button and the copy changes.
notes.author: Ana

notes.title: Read-only on purpose
notes.body: No inline editing here. Changing the time means going back, so the summary and the confirmation can be the same three lines in the same order.
notes.author: Ana

notes.title: Repeats the review, line for line
notes.body: Provider, time, place — same order as the review screen. Anything that moves here reads as a change the patient did not make.
notes.author: Ana
